segments.name: renewable fuels
segments.description: Produces renewable fuels at its plants, principally sustainable aviation fuel sold to offtake partners, serving aviation and renewable fuel markets.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: renewable fuels.

revenueModel.text: Offtake partners such as energy companies, fuel wholesalers and brokers, airlines and fixed-based operators pay for SAF and other renewable fuels produced at the company's plants.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company intends to generate revenues from the sale of its SAF products to offtake partners, which include energy companies, fuel wholesalers and brokers, airlines, or fixed-based operators
